description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing user roles in the application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, enabling/disabling, deleting roles, and managing role permissions. It interacts with underlying services to perform these operations and handles request/response serialization.

classes.name: RolesApiResource
classes.description: The main REST resource class providing endpoints for role management, including CRUD operations, enabling/disabling roles, and permissions management.

methods.name: retrieveAllRoles
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a list of all roles, with optional field filtering.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new role with provided details.

methods.name: retrieveRole
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific role by ID, with optional field filtering.

methods.name: actionsOnRoles
methods.description: Handles POST request to enable or disable a role based on command query parameter.

methods.name: updateRole
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing role's details.

methods.name: retrieveRolePermissions
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve permissions associated with a role.

methods.name: updateRolePermissions
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update the permissions assigned to a role.

methods.name: deleteRole
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a role if it's not associated with any users.
